actionsboardDuo.description: Watch whether your CI is running smoothly. ActionsBoard-Duo shows GitHub Actions status as a quiet tree in the Activity Bar — accounts (servers) down to workflows, branch runs and matrix jobs — with an always-present status bar summary and failure / outage / recovery notifications. Tokens live only in SecretStorage; read-only polling, no tracking.
config.accounts: CI accounts (servers). Each entry is { id, name, baseUrl }. Personal access tokens are NOT stored here; they live in SecretStorage and are entered from the settings form.
config.groups: Groups: named bundles of watched workflows. Each group is { id, name, accountId, workflows: [{ owner, repo, workflow, starred? }] }.
config.livenessInterval: Server liveness check interval in seconds. Runs on its own cycle, separate from build polling; one light request per account per cycle.
config.notificationScope: Which build failures to notify about.
config.notifyFailure: Notify when a watched workflow's newest run fails.
config.notifyOutage: Notify when a CI server becomes unreachable.
config.notifyRecovery: Notify when an unreachable CI server recovers.
config.pollHidden: Build polling interval in seconds while the CI Board view is hidden.
config.pollVisible: Build polling interval in seconds while the CI Board view is visible.
